message.content:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "P1",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "The earliest observable company-first hierarchy departure varies across runs: the report locates it in Idea, Synthesis, or Narrative.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "The first visible editorial hierarchy break varies by run.",
        "In Experiment 008 Company-first runs, selected Idea already changes the hierarchy in A-001 and A-003",
        "candidate 003 is already company/product hierarchy drift in Synthesis.",
        "Narrative is the most recurrent first visible hierarchy shift in the available records."
      ],
      "materiality": "This directly supports a variable starting point rather than a single stage being the universal first location.",
      "boundary": "These are the report’s localizations of observable departures; they do not establish the internal cause of any departure."
    },
    {
      "id": "P2",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "Narrative is the most recurrent first visible hierarchy shift in the reviewed records, but it is not the first locus in every reported case.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "Narrative is the most recurrent first visible hierarchy shift in the available records.",
        "It is first in 007 runs 001–002, 008 A-002 (factual breach) and 009 baseline 002/003 and candidates 001–003.",
        "But it is not a sole root cause: some runs start in Idea or Synthesis, and in 009 baseline 001 the reported factual issue is Compose."
      ],
      "materiality": "Preserves the distinction between recurrence and universality, central to the selected Idea’s qualification.",
      "boundary": "Recurrence does not establish Narrative as a universal root cause or as the first failure for every dimension."
    },
    {
      "id": "P3",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "Experiment 008 reports company-first hierarchy changes already in selected Idea for runs A-001 and A-003.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "A-001 | **Idea** | Compose is selected as the “concrete expression” framing Nuëyon’s identity",
        "A-003 | **Idea** | Selected Idea calls Compose an “orchestration-first philosophy”"
      ],
      "materiality": "Provides direct examples of an early, Idea-stage departure, showing that observed drift is not confined to Narrative.",
      "boundary": "These examples concern the named Experiment 008 runs; they do not show that Idea is generally the first departure."
    },
    {
      "id": "P4",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "Experiment 007 candidate 003 is localized to Synthesis as the earliest supported hierarchy departure in the available trace.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "Candidate 003 | **Synthesis** | Primary message and subject make Compose/orchestration the story; broader company identity and audience become context.",
        "We can localize drift only from Synthesis onward for those chains"
      ],
      "materiality": "Adds a Synthesis-stage example to the range of reported first observable locations.",
      "boundary": "The report does not assess Idea or Research for these chains, so it cannot establish whether the departure began before Synthesis."
    },
    {
      "id": "P5",
      "kind": "causalLimit",
      "proposition": "The report defines “first drift” as an earliest observable departure, not as evidence of internal model causation.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "For each run, “first drift” means the earliest **observable** stage that departs from the requested company-first editorial hierarchy, introduces unsupported material, or makes a materially stronger claim.",
        "It does not imply internal model causation."
      ],
      "materiality": "Prevents interpreting stage localization as proof of where or why the underlying process caused the behavior.",
      "boundary": "The report supports stage-level observations under its stated definition, not a causal account of model behavior."
    },
    {
      "id": "P6",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "Experiment 009 reports that company-first selected Ideas did not ensure the company-first hierarchy survived downstream.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "Experiment 009 shows that a company-first selected Idea is not sufficient.",
        "The evaluation reports the selected Idea kept Nuëyon primary and Compose as first product direction in all six baseline/candidate runs.",
        "The reported issues then appear downstream: orchestration-centered story framing, unsupported audience/validation/outcome language, or a factual overclaim in Compose."
      ],
      "materiality": "Shows a downstream departure can occur even when the selected Idea is reported as company-first, complementing the early-stage examples.",
      "boundary": "This is the report’s summary of six runs; it does not show that every downstream stage or every run failed in the same way."
    },
    {
      "id": "P7",
      "kind": "counterexample",
      "proposition": "Experiment 009 baseline 001 is reported as a Compose-stage factual failure while earlier stages remain company-first and downstream hierarchy is scored 2/2.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "Baseline 001 | **Compose** (reported factual failure)",
        "Selected Idea and earlier chain remain company-first; the artifact’s score gives downstream hierarchy 2/2.",
        "reliable conversion is not established."
      ],
      "materiality": "Distinguishes a factual failure at Compose from a hierarchy departure and prevents treating every late-stage problem as evidence of hierarchy drift.",
      "boundary": "This example does not establish Compose as the first hierarchy-departure stage; the report explicitly says the earlier chain remains company-first."
    },
    {
      "id": "P8",
      "kind": "explicitMeaning",
      "proposition": "The report treats source fidelity and editorial hierarchy as separate dimensions: a technically supported description can still be the wrong lead for a company introduction.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "Factual and editorial failures are distinct.",
        "Orchestration is source-supported as a Compose design principle; making it the defining story of a company introduction can still violate the source’s editorial intent.",
        "The source supports two true propositions that compete editorially: Nuëyon is an AI-first company; orchestration is central to Compose’s design."
      ],
      "materiality": "Clarifies that factual support alone does not determine whether an output preserves the requested company-first hierarchy.",
      "boundary": "This is the report’s stated editorial interpretation; it does not make the supported orchestration proposition factually false."
    },
    {
      "id": "P9",
      "kind": "negativeControl",
      "proposition": "Technical-first framing in Experiment 008 B runs is treated as expected under that condition, not by itself as a company-first hierarchy departure.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "Technical-first B runs intentionally start technical, so their first technical framing in Idea is expected by that condition",
        "In technical-first Experiment 008 B runs, technical hierarchy itself is the intended condition; the table identifies any separate scope/factual breach."
      ],
      "materiality": "Provides a contrast case showing that technical framing must be interpreted against the run’s intended condition before classifying it as drift.",
      "boundary": "Expected technical ordering under B does not demonstrate that the output satisfies a company-first introduction or that its factual claims are sound."
    },
    {
      "id": "P10",
      "kind": "causalLimit",
      "proposition": "The report cautions that Experiment 009’s saved evaluation does not formally assign a first-failure stage to each dimension, and identifies baseline 003 localization as lower confidence.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "Its saved evaluation summarizes the six runs but does not assign a formal first-failure stage to each dimension.",
        "where the exact factual precursor is not explicitly called out (notably baseline 003), the localization is lower confidence."
      ],
      "materiality": "Qualifies the precision of per-run stage localization, particularly where a report summary rather than a formal stage-by-dimension assignment is the basis.",
      "boundary": "This limitation does not negate the report’s broader cross-run observations; it limits confidence in some specific localizations."
    },
    {
      "id": "P11",
      "kind": "causalLimit",
      "proposition": "Upstream format references are reported as an architectural inconsistency and a plausible source of format priming, but not as a demonstrated cause of drift.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "These are direct format references in upstream prompt text.",
        "This is an instruction-boundary inconsistency and a plausible source of format priming",
        "It does **not** demonstrate that these references caused orchestration drift or a weak hook in any given run."
      ],
      "materiality": "Separates an observed prompt-boundary issue from the unproven causal explanation of particular run outcomes.",
      "boundary": "The report does not establish that format references caused any specific hierarchy departure."
    }
  ],
  "ideaChecks": [
    {
      "proposition": "The earliest visible departure from the intended company-first hierarchy varies across runs; Narrative is the most recurrent first visible hierarchy shift, but the evidence does not establish it—or any other stage—as a universal root cause.",
      "sourceItemIds": [
        "P1",
        "P2",
        "P3",
        "P4",
        "P5",
        "P10"
      ],
      "status": "supported"
    }
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Experiment 007 has no Idea or Research extracts for the cited chains; the report says localization is possible only from Synthesis onward.",
    "Experiment 009’s saved evaluation does not formally assign first-failure stages by dimension, and the report marks baseline 003 localization as lower confidence.",
    "The map reflects the supplied diagnostic report’s descriptions of reviewed artifacts; the underlying run artifacts are not separately available here for reinspection."
  ]
}
